name: metrifi
description: The MetriFi plugin: one MetriFi sign-in connects Claude to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) and adds the MetriFi skills: client-report for auditing an institution's existing site, generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process for designing and building one, campaign-setup for standing up a new institution's first baseline campaign, and the GEO experiment skills that run a campaign from research through to a reviewed client deliverable. Self-contained: no other plugins needed. Analyze, design and edit conversion-optimized credit-union and bank websites the MetriFi way.
